ambiguities.description: It's stated a reviewer can review many papers and a paper gets several reviewers, with a reviewer reviewing a given paper at most once. But is the Reviewer-Paper pairing mandatory for a Review to exist, and is it truly a 1:1 correspondence with Review (i.e., does every Reviewer-Paper pairing necessarily have exactly one Review, or could a pairing exist without a completed review yet)? The transcript says 'each completed review gets its own review ID', suggesting Review only exists once completed, but it's unclear whether an in-progress (uncompleted) review assignment is tracked as a distinct concept from Review.
